verdict.rationale: Zulip has no native rule builder in the evidence; event-triggered automation comes from writing custom interactive bots that react to messages, deployed via the Zulip Botserver, or from third-party Zapier/IFTTT and incoming webhooks. Users can get event-to-action behavior, but only through code or external tools. Missing for 10: a native declarative rule/trigger configuration, documented event types beyond messages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the automation workflows.
